run_compute_metrics: run compute_metrics to evaluate a competition submission against the solution using a specified metric
compute_custom_metric: compute a custom metric by downloading metric.py from a HuggingFace competition dataset and calling its compute function
compute_sklearn_metric: compute a sklearn metric by comparing public and private submission splits against the solution CSV
review_compute_metrics: review the compute_metrics function to understand how it handles custom versus standard sklearn metrics
refactor_compute_metrics: refactor compute_metrics to support additional metric types or change the public private split logic
